connector.name: Kvm Pilot
connector.registryDescription: Smart hands for your AI agents - write-capable KVM+BMC+SSH MCP server: gated, verified, audited.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package kvm-pilot. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dustintrap account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KVM_PILOT_PROFILE
env.description: Profile name from ~/.config/kvm-pilot/config.toml naming the KVM/BMC to target

env.name: KVM_PILOT_MCP_READ_ONLY
env.description: Least-privilege posture: only read-only tools are registered; effect gates force-closed. Recommended for first contact (set to 1)

env.name: KVM_PILOT_MCP_DRY_RUN
env.description: Rehearsal posture: destructive calls are logged, never sent (set to 1)

env.name: KVM_PILOT_MCP_ALLOW_POWER
env.description: Operator opt-in enabling power control of the managed host (per-effect gate; see also _ALLOW_HID, _ALLOW_MEDIA, _ALLOW_SSH, _ALLOW_APPLIANCE, _ALLOW_EXTERNAL_WRITE)

env.name: KVM_PILOT_PASSWD
env.description: Device password when not using a config-file profile (KVM_PILOT_HOST / KVM_PILOT_USER accompany it)

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Optional: enables server-side vision for classify_screen / wait_for_state; without it, classification falls back to the calling agent
